title: Software Engineer | Post Trade Analytics
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world-class research. We empower exceptional talent in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting-edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by fostering collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk-adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve complex problems.  Jump Trading's Post-Trade Analytics (PTA) Team is the firm's central source of truth for understanding how we trade. We measure, analyze, and optimize every dimension of our trading activity across all global markets. Our team builds the foundational analyses that traders and quantitative researchers rely on daily to make critical decisions. Operating across highly diverse datasets, our core infrastructure collects, organizes, and stores billions of data points every day, powering the analytics behind a wide array of trading strategies.  As a Software Engineer on the PTA team, you will own the critical datasets and pipelines upon which our trading decisions are built, all while developing in-depth technical and financial business expertise. 
  What You'll Do:  
 
 Partner directly with traders and quantitative researchers to turn complex questions into data products that shape how we trade across global markets. 
 Build, operate, and scale the robust datasets and pipelines that power our post-trade analytics and research. 
 Directly influence business priorities, trading strategies, and execution quality through high-impact data engineering. 
 Guarantee trust in the numbers by building robust data validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, data lineage, and executing rapid incident response. 
 Drive performance by optimizing data processing and workflows for speed, cost, and resilience, while diagnosing and resolving the most complex pipeline and production issues. 
 Develop and optimize the tools, documentation, and foundational infrastructure that empower the broader research and trading teams. 
 Other duties as needed 
 
  Skills You’ll Need:  
 
 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or Software Engineer working extensively with large-scale data. 
 Proficiency in Python or C++ (Strong skills in at least one, with a willingness to work across both). 
 Proven expertise in building, operating, and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management. 
 Strong command of SQL and the broader data analytics ecosystem, including familiarity with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. 
 Sharp analytical and problem-solving abilities, paired with a strong curiosity to understand the financial business logic behind the data. 
 Comfort and proficiency working within Linux environments. 
 Reliable and predictable availability

title: Beijing Office Administrator
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. 
 The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring  Beijing Office Administrators with excellent English  to help take responsibility for the success of our Beijing office and hardware certification lab.  
 Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement. 
  Location:  This is an office-based role based in Beijing. 
 What your day will look like 
 
 Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests 
 Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space 
 Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices 
 Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders 
 Cross team collaboration across the company 
 
 What we are looking for 
 
 Excellent academics 
 Excellent spoken and written English skills 
 Responsible and accountable 
 Self-awareness and thoughtfulness 
 Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration 
 Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements 
 Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
 Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment 
 
 What we offer you 
 We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. 
 
 Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year 
 Annual compensation review 
 Recognition rewards 
 Annual holiday leave 
 Maternity and paternity leave 
 Pension and medical insurance 
 Employee Assistance Program 
 Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues 
 Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events 
 
 About Canonical 
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
  This position is CHINA BASED . The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies. 
   
  The Community You Will Join:  
 Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.  
 The Core ML team in Assistance Engineering is the team responsible for adopting the Agentic AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional customer service experience. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and more! The team is constantly exploring the SOTA Agentic architecture, develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and leverages tools including SFT, Reinforcement learning, Distillation, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb. 
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.  
 You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.  
 Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities. 
   
  A Typical Day:   
 
 
 Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems 
 
 
 Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products 
 
 
 Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).  
 
 
   
  Your Expertise:  
 
 PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience 
 2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.  
 Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products 
 Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations 
  Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.  
 
   
  Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:  
 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.     
   Reasonable Accommodations:  We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.  
   A Note on Recruiting Scams:  Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters

title: Account Development Representative
description:
An Account Development Representative at MongoDB is the starting point for building a serious career in technology sales.  
 This role is the foundation of our sales organization. You will partner closely with Account Executives to identify new opportunities within strategic accounts, helping drive meaningful pipeline and long-term customer growth.   
 From day one, you will learn and apply structured sales frameworks including MEDDIC qualification, account mapping, multi-threading strategies, and value-based discovery. You will develop technical fluency across modern application architectures, cloud infrastructure, and database technologies, gaining real exposure to how complex software solutions are positioned and sold.  ADRs at MongoDB do more than generate meetings. They help shape early deal strategy, apply MEDDIC principles to qualify real business problems, and stay engaged through the scoping phase to maintain strong deal momentum  
 We invest heavily in structured onboarding, ongoing enablement, and consistent 1:1 coaching. Our ADR team is one of the primary talent pipelines into Account Executive and other revenue roles across MongoDB, with clear, performance-based progression paths. 
 Hybrid Model 
 We believe skill development accelerates when teams collaborate in person. This is a hybrid role based in Shanghai, China. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Own outbound prospecting within a defined set of strategic accounts, working closely with your aligned Account Executives and Sales stakeholders. 
 Research organizations to uncover new initiatives and opportunities where MongoDB can add value. 
 Execute thoughtful outbound outreach across phone, email, and social channels to generate qualified pipeline. 
 Lead structured discovery conversations to understand business priorities and technical environments. 
 Apply MEDDIC qualification principles to ensure high-quality opportunities before advancing them. 
 Stay engaged through the early stages of the sales cycle, contributing to strong handoffs and clean deal progression. 
 Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and sales engagement tools. 
 Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity targets. 
 
 We’re looking for someone with 
 
 Has a track record of setting goals and exceeding them in competitive or performance-driven environments. 
 Communicates clearly and confidently in Mandarin and English (fluent). 
 Takes ownership of outcomes and follows through on commitments. 
 Can manage a high level of outbound activity while maintaining quality and attention to detail. 
 Is coachable and actively applies feedback. 
 Learns technical concepts quickly and is curious about how businesses use technology. 
 Is serious about building a long-term career in technology sales. 
 Is comfortable initiating conversations with senior stakeholders and handling rejection professionally. 
 
 Things We Love

title: Cloud Systems Engineer
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. 
 At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems. We are building a small, high-impact team to design and run infrastructure that operates outside Jump's primary environment. This is a broad remit: cloud, production systems, and HPC-style workloads all fall within scope, with sound security practices built in throughout. We are looking for a true generalist who can design systems from the ground up, operate them with little direction, and dig deep when things break. 
  What you’ll do:     
    
 
 Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure that operates independently of Jump's on-premises environment. 
 Architect resilient, reliable systems, with security considered as part of good design from the start. 
 Build independent infrastructure and controls that strengthen Jump's overall resilience. 
 Support production and HPC-style compute workloads in the cloud, including provisioning, scaling, performance, and cost. 
 Own a wide range of systems end to end, from networking and identity to compute, storage, and monitoring. 
 Lead root cause analysis on incidents until the true cause is found and fixed. 
 Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting so problems are detected and resolved quickly. 
 Apply infrastructure security best practices, including access management, secrets management, server hardening, and audit logging. 
 Pivot quickly to whatever needs fixing across the infrastructure, balancing competing priorities with minimal oversight. 
 Work with a globally distributed team to maintain high availability. 
 Other duties as assigned or needed. 
 
    
  Skills you’ll need:     
    
 
 Broad, hands-on experience as an infrastructure generalist, such as Linux administration, DevOps, systems engineering, or SRE. 
 Deep understanding of Linux internals and networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP, routing, and load balancing. 
 Strong experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including networking, IAM, and compute services. 
 Working knowledge of infrastructure security fundamentals, such as IAM, secrets management, system hardening, and logging/audit. 
 A proven track record of troubleshooting complex systems and driving root cause analysis across multiple layers of the stack. 
 Experience designing and architecting systems, not just operating them. 
 Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or Salt. 
 Experience with monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Alertmanager, or Grafana. 
 Proficiency in Bash and Python scripting. Deep software engineering experience is not required. 
 Comfort working in a flat, fast-paced team. 
 Reliable and predictable availability. 
 
 Bonus points:  
 
 Exposure to HPC environments or large-scale compute clusters. 
 Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. 
 Experience with bare-metal and hybrid infrastructure. 
 Additional depth in security, such as incident response or secure architecture design.  
 Experience in trading, financial services, or other high-availability environments.

title: Senior Software Engineer, C++ (Market Data)
description:
Flow Traders Hong Kong is looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to lead the next-generation architecture of the market data and execution platforms that power our fully systematic trading. We don't treat market data as plumbing - for us it's a source of alpha, where feed handling, order book construction, and a deep understanding of exchange microstructure are themselves a competitive edge. We're looking for a senior individual contributor who has lived this philosophy in a proprietary or systematic trading environment and can squeeze every nanosecond out of the path from wire to strategy. 
 As a senior individual contributor, you'll be working on the Core Platform that underpins quantitative research, pricing, strategy development, and execution across hundreds of venues. You'll work in a tight, iterative loop with quants and technical traders, applying deep expertise in modern C++, OS internals, CPU and memory architecture, lock-free concurrency, and low-latency networking to push our systems toward state-of-the-art performance, robustness, and observability. 
 What you will do: 
 
 Design and implement high‑performance components for market data ingestion, normalization, and distribution, as well as its usage for order execution and strategy infrastructure. 
 Develop tools and frameworks that enable quants and technical traders to build, tune, and deploy data‑driven systematic pricing and trading strategies. 
 Own the full lifecycle of your components in a fast‑paced, iterative environment: deploy, monitor, profile, and optimize your code in production. 
 Work closely with focus group engineers, quants, and technical traders to refine requirements, collect feedback, and iterate on the platform's design and implementation. 
 
 What you need to succeed: 
 
 BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 5+ years of post‑graduation professional C++ software development experience. 
 Experience building low‑latency market data ingestion, order execution, and algorithmic trading systems in the trading/ financial services industry. 
 Strong knowledge in one or more APAC markets.  
 Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures. 
 Experience in parallel, asynchronous, and multithreaded programming. 
 Demonstrated ability to write clean, reliable, and highly scalable C++ code. 
 Interest in extracting maximum performance from available hardware and software (CPU caches, memory layout, networking, etc.). 
 Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical colleagues.

title: Sr. Analyst, Business Development - Consumer
description:
About AppLovin   
  AppLovin  makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit:  www.applovin.com . 
  To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others.     About AppLovin’s Consumer Team  
 We are powering the next wave of consumer growth. Specializing in performance advertising, we help global brands and leading consumer apps across verticals such as e-Commerce / DTC, fintech, meal delivery, ride hailing, video streaming and more achieve profitable growth by connecting them to over 1 billion daily users across thousands of the world’s top mobile games apps. This scale is driven by AppLovin’s advertising platform, which enables businesses of all sizes to find their ideal customers and maximize ROI. 
 AppLovin’s global team combines people from different backgrounds and perspectives, united by a shared ambition to always pursue excellence and win together in a fast-moving market. We are intentional about the culture we are building and seek candidates who are outstanding in their own right while remaining deeply committed to the success of others. 
   
  Please note that this role requires onsite presence at our Beijing or Shanghai office.  
   
  About the Role  
 We are seeking a driven, analytical, and results-focused  Sr. Analyst, Business Development  to join our fast-paced and expanding Consumer (eCommerce & Apps) team in Beijing or Shanghai. This is a unique opportunity to shape a new business line from the ground up and work at the intersection of performance marketing and business development within the rapidly growing Consumer(eCommerce & Apps) space. 
 In this client-facing role, you’ll partner with eCommerce brands and non-gaming Apps to unlock growth by leveraging AppLovin’s marketing platform. You’ll build strong relationships with key stakeholders, help them optimize campaigns, and lead strategic initiatives that drive business outcomes. You’ll also work closely with AppLovin leadership and product experts to evolve our Consumer advertising solution and drive adoption in the market. 
   
  Responsibilities  
 
 Own the onboarding, campaign launch, and day-to-day growth of a portfolio of eCommerce clients, educating partners on AppLovin’s Consumer growth solution. 
 Develop data-backed account plans based on each partner’s business objectives, growth priorities, and performance targets. 
 Launch and optimize campaigns by applying best practices across measurement, creative strategy, testing, and performance targets. 
 Define and analyze key metrics, identify performance issues, and translate complex data into clear recommendations and actions. 
 Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and communicate campaign performance, product updates, and growth opportunities effectively. 
 Coordinate with Product, Operations, Technical, Creative, and other Business Development teams to resolve account issues and execute growth initiatives. 
 Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and independently lead routine commercial discussions, escalating complex negotiations when appropriate. 
 Share learnings and best practices across the regional Business Development team.

 3–5 years of professional experience in account management, business development, sales, performance marketing, media buying, digital strategy, or a related field. 
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

title: 生产技术员
description:
1. 设施大棚种植管理：全面负责园区连栋棚、单体大棚内各类蔬果（番茄、莴苣、草莓、瓜果、叶菜等）全周期种植技术管理，涵盖育苗、定植、水肥管控、整枝修剪、疏花疏果、病虫害绿色防控、适时采收等全流程标准化作业，制定大棚作物种植技术方案并落地执行。
2. 大田作物技术管控：负责园区大田经济作物、观赏作物的种植规划与技术指导，包含播种育苗、田间管护、土壤改良、肥料配比、杂草清理、长势监测、产量品质管控等工作，根据气候、土壤情况动态调整种植方案，保障作物稳产优产。
3. 生产台账与报表上报：严格落实园区生产管理制度，每日记录农事作业、农资使用、作物长势、病虫害情况，整理种植生产数据，按时完成企业微信日常生产记录、周度/月度生产报表上报工作。
4. 田间团队指导：指导一线种植工人规范开展农事操作，纠正不标准作业流程，普及科学种植技术，提升整体种植效率与农产品品质，严控种植损耗。
5. 园区绿化基础维护：负责园区绿化植被、观赏绿植、景观花草的日常养护，包含浇水施肥、修剪整形、杂草清除、绿植补种、病虫害防治，保障园区绿化整洁美观、景观效果完好。
6. 物资与成本管控：合理规划种子、肥料、农药、农资耗材的使用，做好物资登记领用，严控种植生产成本，配合完成园区农业生产降本增效工作。
7. 日常巡查与应急处置：每日巡查大棚、大田、绿化区域，及时发现旱涝、冻害、病虫害、设施轻微故障等问题，快速制定处置方案，规避种植风险；完成领导交办的其他农业生产及园区管护相关工作。

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, AI Gateway
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
 Netskope AI Gateway helps global enterprises securely adopt, scale, and govern Generative AI. We are seeking a  Staff / Sr. Staff Software Engineer  to architect, build, and scale the core systems powering our AI Gateway product and its supporting microservices across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid environments. 
 Based in Taiwan, you will be a technical anchor for our core development team. This is a hands-on, high-impact individual contributor role focused on building highly scalable backend systems, with real ownership: the systems assigned to you are yours to design, build, and defend — depth matters more than volume. You will operate at the intersection of deep distributed systems engineering and cutting-edge AI technology. We are looking for an engineering leader who leverages AI to accelerate their workflows, but possesses the rigorous, production-grade coding skills required to architect complex systems, ensure enterprise-grade security, and validate AI-generated code. 
  What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Core Backend Development:  Architect, build, and scale our core AI Gateway solutions, backend services, and high-throughput APIs. You will focus on writing highly concurrent, robust, and maintainable software, primarily in  Golang . 
  Command AI-Driven Engineering:  Integrate AI and agent-based tooling (e.g., Copilots, code generators) into your daily development workflow to accelerate scaffolding, boilerplate, and hypothesis generation.  Crucially, you will act as the gatekeeper:  you must possess the deep software engineering expertise to audit AI-generated code, ensure architectural soundness, and reject code that introduces technical debt or security flaws. 
  Design for Scale and Resilience:  Build distributed systems capable of handling immense data payloads, streaming LLM responses (Server-Sent Events), and complex proxy routing without introducing unacceptable latency. 
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner directly with global engineering, AI researchers, and product teams. Translate ambitious AI features into scalable, maintainable software architectures. Raise system design considerations before a single line of feature code is written. 
  Push Engineering Excellence:  Drive the technical culture of the Taiwan team through architectural reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. Advocate for best practices in modern, AI-augmented software development, security, and scalable system design. 
  Deep Systems Debugging:  While not primarily an incident support role, you will be the ultimate escalation point for the hardest systemic development roadblocks. Trace complex issues across asynchronous microservice

 The role will cover strategic enterprise customers within the Greater China region.  
 Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity. 
  The impact you will have  
 
 Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.

 Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.

description:

扁平化管理，不搞虚形式，实干多得、结果说话，晋升通道清晰。

You will be the primary hands-on technologist on our St. Louis support team, resolving employee issues while continuously driving down ticket volume through intelligent automation and self-service. title: Android BSP Engineer
description:
About Stripe  
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.  
  About the team  
 Stripe Terminal helps Stripe users extend their online presence into the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payments use cases that are right for their business model—whether it’s creating a flagship retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point-of-sale at their next event.  
  What we are looking for:  
 As an Android BSP Engineer, you will be responsible for the kernel and driver level system development, which includes building, troubleshooting, and writing automated tests for the Android system on our embedded payments platforms. This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android app teams. We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up. 
  What you’ll do:  
 
 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams. 
 Design, implement, and maintain drivers and Android services that operate efficiently in a constrained environment and meet the reliability and security requirements of the industry. 
 Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers and communication, and power and performance management and optimization. 
 Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status). 
 Interact with global teams with excellent communication skills to provide support information 
 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation 
 Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product/feature development. Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed. 
 Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance. 
 
  Who you are  
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
  Minimum requirements  
 
 2+ years software engineering experience in device driver development, embedded systems, or operating systems 
 2+ years working with mobile or other connected devices 
 Experience using automated testing, build systems, and inter-component communication protocols such as UART, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc. 
 Proficiency in C/C++ or Kotlin/Java 
 Experience with Android OS, and familiarity with associated software development tools 
 Degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical experience 
 Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues 
 Fluency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese to be able to communicate with our vendors and users/customers 
 
  Preferred qualifications  
 
 Experience with ARM platform 
 Experience working with microcontrollers 
 Knowledge of EMV. 
 Knowledge of cryptography, symmetric, asymmetric, key management and exchange is an asset. 
 Experience with POS Hardware and peripherals. 
 Knowledge and expertise of PCI technology, transaction processing, and related retail standards.

title: Senior New Business Manager
description:
About Moloco:  
 Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet. 
 Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.   Moloco Ads   is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.   Moloco Commerce Media   is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by  CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture) , the AI system behind every Moloco product. 
 At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.  Come build what's next.     The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco  
 As a  Senior New Business Manager  for  Greater China , you will own the end‑to‑end acquisition and closing of strategic new logos across mobile apps, gaming, commerce, and streaming in the region. You will develop and execute account‑ and vertical‑level strategies, navigate multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, and shape how prospects in Greater China understand Moloco’s role in their growth. You’ll partner closely with New Business leadership, Growth, Implementation, Product, Data Science, and Marketing to identify the right prospects, craft compelling value propositions, and close complex deals that set customers up for long‑term success. 
  What You’ll Do  
  Partner Leadership & Pipeline Ownership  
 
 Own end‑to‑end new business sales cycles for a portfolio of high‑potential Greater China prospects, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close, with limited input from senior management. 
 Develop and execute account‑level and vertical‑level sales strategies that align Moloco’s solutions with each prospect’s business objectives and long‑term growth plans in Greater China. 
 Build and deepen relationships with management‑level and budget‑holding decision makers (e.g., Heads of UA, CMOs, business owners), earning the right to influence buying decisions and long‑term partnership vision. 
 Maintain a disciplined, accurate pipeline and forecast in CRM, providing clear visibility into deal stages, risks, and upside for the Greater China business. 
 
  Commercial Excellence & Deal Making  
 
 Identify and qualify performance‑driven upsell and expansion opportunities within your book of business in Greater China, designing proposals that balance client outcomes and Moloco revenue. 
 Lead complex deal structuring and negotiations (pricing, terms, tests, incentives) to overcome objections and close high‑value opportunities, leveraging data, benchmarks, and clear trade‑off narratives. 
 Use data‑driven storytelling to articulate business cases, quantify impact, and influence senior client stakeholders to take action (e.g., budget shifts, new product adoption, geo expansion). 
 Partner with Implementation and Growth to ensure clean handoffs and successful ramp‑up for new wins, aligning expectations on KPIs, timelines, and success criteria for the first 90 days and beyond. 
 
  Product Leadership & Solution Design  
 
 Develop a sophisticated understanding of Moloco’s products and the programmatic ecosystem in Greater China, including how our DSP and commerce/streaming solutions fit into a prospect’s broader tech and media stack. 
 Translate prospect needs and pain points into tailored solution designs and test plans, collaborating with Product, DS, and Growth to ensure feasibility, scalability, and strong product‑market fit in the region.

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, Data Engineering
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
  Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
 Netskope's Data Platform is the backbone behind every security insight our customers see, ingesting and processing security telemetry from a global edge network at massive scale. We own the full data path — from collection at the edge, through stream processing and enrichment, to the query, routing, and delivery systems that put that data in customers' hands. On top of that foundation we build the analytics, reporting, and export capabilities that our customers rely on to understand and act on their security posture. We are now investing in an AI-native future, building a semantic layer that makes our data machine-interpretable and agentic experiences that let customers ask questions of their data in natural language. 
  What you’ll work on  
 
 Partner with architects to design and evolve the systems that carry telemetry from global edge ingestion through processing, query, and customer delivery, with a focus on scale, durability & latency. 
 Raise the bar on observability, SLOs, deployment safety, and production resilience of the platform that others build on top of - not just a single service. 
 Build the AI-native semantic layer that’s the foundation to make our data machine-interpretable, and the agentic experiences on top of it that let customers ask questions in natural language.  
 Lead cross-team initiatives, shaping architecture through design reviews, and mentoring engineers, with the freedom to adopt modern & open source technologies. 
 
  Required skills and experience  
 
 10+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with significant time operating at Staff-level (or equivalent) technical scope. 
 Strong coding ability in one or more of Go, Java, Python, or C++, with a track record of shipping production systems, not just designing them. 
 Experience designing for reliability at scale — observability, SLOs, incident response, and safe deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes). 
 Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: influencing architecture decisions, driving design decisions, and aligning teams around a direction. 
 Experience building high-throughput ingestion and data services over modern RPC and wire protocols — HTTP/2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers — including schema design and evolution.  
 Experience with high-throughput data pipelines — data streaming & batch ingestion, processing, and storage using columnar data formats such as Parquet  
 Excellent written and verbal communication, and the flexibility to collaborate across time zones with globally distributed teams.

title: 政策与调查研究专员
description:
一、主要岗位职责
1.负责起草、修订集团重要文稿、规划报告、调研报告、政策分析报告、工作汇报等文稿工作。
2.根据集团战略部署及部门工作安排，开展行业现状、市场行情、业务痛点、产业趋势等专项调查研究工作，通过实地调研、数据搜集、资料整理等方式，汇总分析关键信息，形成客观、可行的调研报告。
3.持续跟踪国家、地方及行业主管部门出台的相关政策、法律法规、产业规划、行业新规，及时梳理政策要点、解读政策导向，分析政策对集团经营、产业布局的影响，定期输出政策解读报告。
4.建立政策研究、调研成果资料库，对各类政策文件、调研数据、研究报告、文稿材料进行分类整理、归档留存，持续沉淀研究成果，搭建完善的研究素材体系。
二、任职要求
1.大学本科及以上学历，中文、新闻、影视传媒、工商管理等相关专业。
2.具备相关文稿撰写、调研分析、政策研究工作经验，具有影视传媒、文化产业、国企战略研究、政府调研相关从业经验者优先。
3.具备较强的公文、调研报告撰写能力，熟练掌握公文写作规范。
4.具备良好的资料搜集、数据整理、归纳分析能力，能够快速吃透政策、梳理核心信息。
5.具有敏锐的政策洞察力、行业研判能力和逻辑思维能力，善于提炼核心观点、总结问题、输出有效结论。
6.具备高度的责任心、执行力、抗压能力强，能够适应重要文稿攻坚、专项调研等紧急工作；具备良好的团队协作能力、自主学习能力，可快速熟悉集团业务及行业政策体系。
7.有成熟的调研报告、政策分析文稿作品者优先。
8.中共党员优先。
9.无违法犯罪记录。

title: Growth Marketing Manager, GCR
description:
Growth Marketing Manager, GCR  
 At AppsFlyer, we believe great marketing doesn't just build brands—it drives business growth. As the Growth Marketing Manager for GCR, you will play an important role in shaping how we connect with customers, create meaningful touchpoints across their lifecycle, and transform marketing influence into real pipeline impact. 
 In this role, you will lead the evaluation and analysis of integrated, multi-channel marketing strategies/plans across events, content, ABM, digital and owned media. You will analyze performance end-to-end to uncover insights that drive and accelerate new logo acquisition, upsell, and renewal to assist the marketing leadership to define and optimize the marketing strategies and plans in the GCR market. 
 We are looking for a strategic, data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between marketing activity and business results, thrives in cross-functional environments, and brings strong ownership to everything they do. This person should be able to understand and facilitate the diversified marketing activities that generate relevant, sales-ready leads that can be nurtured into qualified opportunities, while also driving upsell and renewal acceleration through various marketing initiatives. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Partner closely with Sales to evaluate the full inbound revenue funnel, gaining a clear understanding of how marketing activities influence lead quality, sales velocity, pipeline acceleration, and overall revenue performance. 
 Support Marketing leadership in designing scalable inbound strategies that consistently generate qualified leads and accelerate pipeline creation in the GCR market. Lead regional pipeline analysis, extract actionable insights, and drive ongoing optimization across all marketing efforts. 
 Build and manage goal-setting and performance measurement across all inbound marketing channels—including ABM programs, content initiatives, events, and digital touchpoints—covering planning, data tracking, analysis, and reporting. 
 Lead the evaluation, implementation, and adoption of marketing automation tools for the GCR market, and as the main POC for GCR to work closely with Global Marketing Operations to streamline lead processes and optimize nurturing activities. 
 Direct paid media efforts across GCR (SEM, social ads, vertical ads, and other paid online channels including lead gen, inbound, ABM, and content syndication), work closely with global growth marketing team and in partnership with paid media agencies—owning ROI management, test-and-learn strategies, and in-market test plans, and working with Sales to connect ad performance to pipeline and revenue impact. 
 Own GCR digital assets—including the regional website and LPs—managing day-to-day operations and maintenance, and serving as the interface between the GCR Marketing team and HQ counterparts.

We were built by people who came out of the industry we serve, and staying close to that problem is still how we operate.

We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.

We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer
location: Home Based - APAC; Office Based - Beijing, China; Office Based - Taipei, Taiwan
description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale. 
 The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality and Test Engineering
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform,  Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives  such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. 
 The company is founder led, profitable and growing. 
 We are hiring an  Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality Engineering , to lead the team responsible for the test suites which validate hardware compatibility with Ubuntu Linux (Core, Desktop and Server – see  https://ubuntu.com/certified  for more information). We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices. 
 As the Engineering Manager of the Certification Quality team you’ll lead a dedicated testing team, shaping the vision and setting the pace, in collaboration with the rest of the Certification and hardware enablement teams. You will lead the certification test strategy for Canonical’s PC OEM and ODM partnerships, including Advantech, ASUS, Dell, HP,  and Lenovo, deepening the test coverage for both new and existing certified hardware. You will pioneer the use of Canonical’s open source test frameworks and custom designed hardware to drive automated hardware validation of the operating system. This is a challenging position for a quality focused engineering leader, and requires an analytical mind with a passion for test automation and team leadership. 
  Location:  This role will be office based in Taipei Minsheng district, Taiwan. 
 This role entails 
 
 Lead the development and maintenance of Canonical’s hardware certification test suite 
 Manage timely delivery of certifications as part of the hardware certification programmes 
 Work collaboratively to ensure continuous improvement of test practices and tools 
 Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers 
 Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development 
 Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders 
 Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation

 Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

 Knowledge of low-level embedded software and hardware - BIOS, firmware, bootloaders, ACPI, devicetree, kernel, RTOS 
 A good understanding of Linux system architecture 
 Knowledge of quality and reliability oriented engineering practices 
 Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

 Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
